cards.title: Ghandruk Village
cards.blurb: A Gurung village of slate-roofed stone houses, with Annapurna South and Machhapuchhre filling the sky above the terraces.

cards.title: Poon Hill Sunrise
cards.blurb: At 3,210 m, the most famous viewpoint on the Annapurna circuit — a panorama from Dhaulagiri to Annapurna I.

cards.title: Ghorepani Rhododendrons
cards.blurb: In spring the forest above Ghorepani turns red and pink with laliguras, Nepal's national flower.

cards.title: Sikles Village
cards.blurb: One of the largest Gurung settlements, a cluster of stone houses on a ridge facing Lamjung Himal.

cards.title: Gurung Bhangra Shawl
cards.blurb: A handwoven nettle-fibre wrap worn over the shoulder, a traditional Gurung garment.

cards.title: Gurung Homestay
cards.blurb: Stay with a family in the village, or pitch a tent outside it. Roll to see how warm a welcome you get.

cards.title: Rodhi Ghar Evening
cards.blurb: Songs and dancing around the fire in the village rodhi house. Everyone at the table collects.

cards.title: Tea-House Race
cards.blurb: First to the next tea house gets the warm room. Challenge one traveller — highest roll wins the bed.
